title: testing-sheet-run/1
description: The last line of stdout of `testing sheets run ... --result` (docs/SHEETS.md): what ran and what was written, for a program that started the run. The exit code is 1 for a red sheet and for a task that could not be written alike; `red` and `written` tell the two apart. A run that was refused or could not start (exit 2, or 3 before a sheet ran), or whose Result-IR could not be written, prints no document. Texts carry no control characters and no more than about 300 characters. A reader ignores unknown fields and refuses a higher schema.

exit.description: The exit code of the command: 0 green and written, 1 a sheet is red or a task was not written, 3 the engine of tasks.nvim could not be reached after the sheets ran (`problem`). A run whose Result-IR (`--json`) could not be written also ends with 3, but prints no document.

task.description: The task of `--task`; null for `--all` and `--sheet`.

sheets.description: The sheets of the run, in the order they ran.

red.description: A sheet is red: it failed or does not load; under `--strict` a skipped sheet too.

tasks.description: With `--tasks`: what became of the block of each task. Empty without it.

written.description: Whether every task's block stands as the run left it (`changed`, `unchanged`; `would_change` under `--dry-run`). false: at least one was not written, or tasks.nvim could not be reached (`problem`). null: nothing was to be written (no `--tasks`).

problem.description: Why no task could be written at all (exit 3).

id.description: The id of the sheet; of a sheet that does not load, its file below the root.

status.description: skip: it could not run here (no browser, a live sheet without --live); a sheet that waits for a person's judgement is pass.

unstarted.description: Only on a failed sheet, and only true: every failure is a child that did not start in time (a busy machine, a low CPU priority). The sheet is red, but its steps did not run: no finding of the sheet. Absent otherwise.

runs.description: Only with `--repeat N`: how often the sheet ran (fewer than N when a run was red or skipped; that run counts).

timings.description: Only with `--repeat N`: one row per step that ran, in the order they first ran, and one more per browser `wait` (`kind = after`): the time from the start of the step that acted (`after_n`) to the moment its condition held. Milliseconds, measured next to the target.

measures.description: Only with `--repeat N`: one row per `measure` step; one reading per run (the median of its `runs`), in the step's `unit`.

sd.description: The sample standard deviation; 0 for one reading.

values.description: The readings, in the order of the runs.

n.description: The number of the step, from 1.

step.description: What the step is (`click #save`), as a failure line names it.

kind.description: step: the step itself; after: a `wait` from the start of step `after_n`.

outcome.description: changed, unchanged, would_change (a dry run): the block stands. failed (a conflict, a refusal, broken markers), missing (not an open task), truncated (not read, or too long to send back): it does not. A reader takes any other word as not written.

message.description: The reason of an outcome that is not written.
